name: Alternate Assist Mod
description: Manual-activated adaptive Ship stabilizer. Captures manual clicks while in Ship mode, then controls press/release from vertical-velocity feedback. Straightness and click-cadence alignment are configurable.

assist-enabled.name: Enable Ship Assist
assist-enabled.description: When enabled in Ship mode, your clicks arm the stabilizer. The controller then manages press/release to keep vertical velocity near the selected target. It disengages after the activity window expires.

straightness.name: Straightness
straightness.description: Main control. 0 = loose correction, 100 = extremely tight horizontal-velocity correction. Higher values shrink the vertical-velocity deadzone directly.

max-cps.name: Maximum CPS
max-cps.description: Maximum complete automatic press/release cycles per second. Higher values allow faster correction; physics updates still set the real limit.

target-vertical-velocity.name: Target Vertical Velocity
target-vertical-velocity.description: Target gravity-relative vertical velocity. 0 targets horizontal flight; positive/negative values allow a controlled slow drift.

manual-activity-window.name: Manual Activity Window
manual-activity-window.description: How long stabilization remains armed after your latest physical click. Holding the button keeps it active; when you stop clicking and release, it disengages after this window.

input-alignment.name: Manual Click Alignment
input-alignment.description: How strongly faster manual click cadence tightens the velocity deadzone. At 100%, fast clicking can tighten the correction threshold by up to 42%.

manual-resume-delay.name: Correction Resume Delay
manual-resume-delay.description: Optional pause after a physical release before the controller resumes corrections. 0 gives immediate correction.

player2-enabled.name: Enable Player 2 Assist
player2-enabled.description: Enables the same controller for Player 2 in dual mode. Disabled by default.

debug-telemetry.name: Debug Controller Telemetry
debug-telemetry.description: Logs measured and predicted vertical velocity, effective deadzone, controller output, measured manual CPS, Straightness, and estimated acceleration.
